mcqs.question: Which symbol on a food product indicates that it conforms to the standards set by the Agricultural Marketing Development Board of India?
mcqs.explanation: The Agmark logo is the official certification mark for agricultural produce and food items that meet the quality standards prescribed by the Agricultural Marketing Development Board. ISI relates to Indian Standards for industrial goods, Hallmark to gold purity, and FSSAI to food safety, so only Agmark correctly identifies the standardisation of agricultural products.

mcqs.question: A gold necklace bears the "22K Hallmark" stamp. What does this hallmark assure the consumer?

options.B: The gold purity is 22 carats (approximately 91.6% pure)
options.C: The design is approved by the Bureau of Indian Standards
options.D: The necklace is the cheapest option in the market

mcqs.answer: The gold purity is 22 carats (approximately 91.6% pure)
mcqs.explanation: Hallmarks on gold jewellery indicate the purity of the gold. A "22K Hallmark" means the gold is 22 karats, i.e., about 91.6% pure gold. It does not convey weight, design approval, or price information.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand the importance of checking product information
mcqs.question: Rita wants to buy a packet of wheat flour. Which pieces of information should she examine on the pack to ensure she makes an informed choice?

options.A: Only the brand name printed on the front
options.B: Expiry date, nutritional information, and any certification marks
options.C: The price and the colour of the packaging
options.D: The number of packets in the box

mcqs.answer: Expiry date, nutritional information, and any certification marks
mcqs.explanation: Checking the expiry date ensures the product is safe to consume, nutritional information tells the consumer about its health value, and certification marks (like Agmark) confirm quality standards. Brand name alone, price, or packaging colour do not guarantee safety or quality.

mcqs.question: A consumer notices the ISI mark on a kitchen blender. What does this mark signify about the product?

options.A: The blender is made from recycled materials
options.B: The blender complies with Indian Standards for safety and performance
options.C: The blender is the cheapest model available
options.D: The blender is imported from abroad

mcqs.answer: The blender complies with Indian Standards for safety and performance
mcqs.explanation: The ISI (Indian Standards Institute) mark indicates that the product has been tested and meets the Indian Standards set for safety, quality, and performance. It does not convey information about material recyclability, price, or origin.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the ISI mark is FALSE?

options.A: It certifies that the product meets Indian Standards
options.B: It is issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards
options.C: It guarantees that the product will be the cheapest in the market
options.D: It is mandatory for certain categories of products

mcqs.answer: It guarantees that the product will be the cheapest in the market
mcqs.explanation: The ISI mark confirms compliance with Indian Standards and is issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards; it may be mandatory for specific product categories. However, it does not guarantee any price advantage, making option C the false statement.

mcqs.question: If a jar of mango pulp displays the Agmark logo, what logical conclusion can a consumer draw?

options.A: The mango pulp is imported from another country
options.B: The mango pulp contains a minimum percentage of mango solids as per Agmark standards
options.C: The product is free from any preservatives
options.D: The product is the cheapest mango pulp available

mcqs.answer: The mango pulp contains a minimum percentage of mango solids as per Agmark standards
mcqs.explanation: Agmark certification ensures that the product meets specific quality criteria, including a minimum mango solid content. It does not indicate import status, preservative-free nature, or price level.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly contrasts the Hallmark and ISI marks?

options.A: Hallmark relates to gold purity, while ISI indicates conformity to Indian product standards
options.B: Hallmark is used for food items, whereas ISI is used exclusively for jewellery
options.C: Hallmark is mandatory for all gold items, while ISI is optional for all products
options.D: Hallmark guarantees organic certification, while ISI guarantees fair‑trade certification

mcqs.answer: Hallmark relates to gold purity, while ISI indicates conformity to Indian product standards
mcqs.explanation: Hallmarks are stamps on gold and silver items indicating their purity. The ISI mark shows that a product, such as appliances or tools, meets Indian Standards. The other options mix up the domains and purposes of the two marks.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand the importance of checking product information
mcqs.question: In the context of consumer rights, which practice is most effective for ensuring the safety and quality of a purchased product?

options.B: Relying solely on the seller’s verbal assurance
options.C: Checking certification marks, expiry dates, and label information before purchase
options.D: Ignoring product labels and focusing only on packaging design

mcqs.answer: Checking certification marks, expiry dates, and label information before purchase
mcqs.explanation: Exam‑style questions emphasize that the safest approach is to verify certification marks (e.g., Agmark, ISI), expiry dates, and detailed label information. Price, verbal claims, or aesthetics alone do not guarantee safety or quality.
